observations: Photo 0 shows a bulky CRT-style television set, viewed from above/front at an angle.
The LG logo is visible on the lower bezel of the screen in photo 0.
No model number or rating label is visible in the photo.
The screen is off/dark; a faint circular icon visible is the photo-viewer's own loading spinner overlay, not a screen artifact from the TV.
The unit appears dusty, used, and sitting on what looks like a floor near a window, consistent with storage rather than active use.
No remote control is visible in the photo.
No back panel, ports, or cable shots are provided.
Seller's new reply is text only, asserting the claims are true; no new photo or video was provided.

claims.evidence: No power-on photo or video provided to confirm what 'not functioning' means.

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen
claims.evidence: Screen is off in photo 0; seller's verbal reassurance does not substitute for visual proof, and this claim still sits oddly with 'not functioning properly'.
No remote is shown in any photo; seller's words alone do not confirm it.
No internal or service-sticker photo provided; this is a history claim that cannot be checked from outside.

claims.claim: "I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true"
claims.evidence: A verbal assurance with no accompanying photo or video is not visual proof; treated as seller's word only.

risks.risk: True nature/severity of the fault is unknown (tube dead, power supply fault, board fault, etc.), which drives whether this has any functional value or only scrap/parts value.
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the TV plugged in and powered on, showing the screen state.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional, parts/scrap value only

risks.risk: Seller's claim of a clean screen (no dead pixels/lines) cannot be checked since the unit is off in the only photo.
risks.proof: Photo of the screen powered on displaying a test pattern or normal picture.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if screen condition is unknown/possibly damaged, not assumed clean

risks.risk: Remote inclusion is unconfirmed; CRT remotes are often lost and can affect bundled value.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual remote next to the TV.
risks.if_unproven: priced as TV only, no remote

risks.risk: Physical/internal damage (cracked tube, corrosion, missing parts inside) not visible from a single external angle.
risks.proof: Photos of the back panel, ports, and any visible internal damage, plus full front/side/back views.
risks.if_unproven: priced at low scrap/parts worst case

risks.risk: Pickup logistics (weight, stairs, distance in Oshodi) could add hidden cost, though this does not change item value itself.
risks.proof: Not price-relevant to the item; not a photo risk.
risks.if_unproven: not priced in; buyer's logistics concern only

proof_requests: Video or photo of the TV plugged in and powered on, showing current screen behavior.
Photo of the back panel and ports.
Photo of the remote control claimed to be included.
Wider shots from multiple angles (full front, side, back) to check for cracks or missing parts.
response.reason: A text-only reassurance with no new photo does not upgrade any claim's verdict; the item remains priced at its worst case as a non-functioning scrap LG CRT TV, with the seller's own description already framing it as such.
